message.content:
ANSWER: عدد الروابط الجلايكوسيدية هو 19.
FINAL: C
message.reasoning_content: We need number of glycosidic bonds formed from 20 lactose molecules? Lactose is disaccharide, formed by one glycosidic bond per molecule. So 20 molecules have 20 bonds? But maybe linking them linearly gives 19 bonds if polymerizing 20 units. Question Arabic: "إذا كان لديك (20) جزيء لاكتوز ، ما عدد الروابط الجلايكوسيدية المتكونة :" Means if you have 20 lactose molecules, how many glycosidic bonds are formed? Likely polymerization to form a polysaccharide chain uses 19 bonds (n-1). So answer C 19.
